jobs.title: Product Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
SumUp empowers businesses to get paid effortlessly, process orders fast, sell online in minutes, and manage their money with confidence. We build the tools that help businesses — and their customer experiences — thrive.

Brazil's Banking Product team sits at the intersection of regulation, payments infrastructure, and product delivery, managing a complex ecosystem of third-party partners, Central Bank requirements, and operational processes that keep millions of transactions running reliably every day. With our banking products continuing to grow, we're creating a dedicated Product Operations Analyst role to strengthen our operational excellence and help the team scale effectively.

In this role, you'll own the operational foundation that enables the team to move quickly and confidently. You'll drive regulatory and operational processes, coordinate cross-functional execution, and ensure our banking products operate smoothly and remain compliant, creating the conditions for Product Managers to focus on strategy, innovation, and delivering new value for our merchants.

What you'll do

- Monitor and evaluate Central Bank of Brazil requirements, coordinate regulatory submissions, and support annual certification processes across the banking ecosystem

- Run and validate monthly transaction uploads into Snowflake, ensuring reconciliation and audit processes are completed accurately and on time

- Manage ticket and inbox operations, maintain SLA visibility, and prepare structured summaries and escalations for Product Managers

- Track and communicate operational changes through governance workflows, keeping all updates documented and traceable across teams

- Coordinate logistics and follow-ups for routine stakeholder meetings with internal teams and external partners such as Pismo, Thales, and Mastercard

- Identify recurring friction points in operational workflows and propose structured improvements to reduce manual effort over time

You'll be great for this role if…

- Experience working with banking, payment systems, or similarly complex integration-based ecosystems, with a solid understanding of how operational and regulatory processes interact

- Proven ability to manage cross-functional delivery across Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders, keeping priorities clear and ownership well-de fined

- Strong organisational skills and comfort handling high volumes of partner-driven changes, balancing urgency with the discipline to introduce structure over time

- Ability to interpret external partner requirements such as file changes, compliance updates, or configuration adjustments, and translate them into clear, actionable tasks

- Clear written and verbal communication in both Portuguese and advanced English, with the confidence to align stakeholders and document decisions precisely

- Basic SQL skills and a process-improvement mindset, with a natural drive to reduce manual overhead and build more reliable workflows

Why you should join SumUp

🌍 Global Experience: Collaborate with a diverse team of 3,000+ people from over 90 countries, and join our global off-sites and hackathons.

🤝 Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.

📈 Career Growth : Be part of a global team working on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses.

💙 Great Benefits : Health plans, meal vouchers (VR), Zenklub, Wellhub, life insurance, childcare allowance, and more.

📚 Learning & Development : Access an annual budget of  R$ 10,000 for education, certifications, and conferences.

🌴 Time Off : Enjoy  30 additional days off  through our  Break4Me program after 3 years at SumUp.

💸 Grow with Us: Participate in our virtual stock program and benefit from SumUp’s success with company shares.

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters. At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team Opens in new window of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst - Consumer Growth
jobs.description:
About the team

SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way.

As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates

If you want to be the person leadership turns to for an honest read of the business, and to see your analysis change real product and commercial decisions, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Shape commercial decisions

- Own the SumUp Consumer KPI framework end to end — defining which metrics matter, how they're measured and how they connect customer behaviour to commercial outcomes.

- Evaluate the quality of our growth: CAC, source attribution, channel performance and downstream customer value, separating headline growth from sustainable growth.

- Work with Risk and Anti-Fraud so fraud, abuse and economic loss are built into how we judge customers, channels and markets.

Drive product decisions

- Diagnose where customers drop out between acquisition and activation, and which behaviours drive repeat usage, retention and lifetime value.

- Design and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer and commercial impact.

- Help Product Managers size opportunities and judge whether shipped features delivered the outcomes they promised.

Influence with data

- Act as an independent analytical partner to Consumer leadership and to Product, Growth, Finance and Risk — proactively surfacing trends, risks and opportunities rather than waiting for requests. Challenge assumptions, metric definitions and interpretations constructively when the evidence points elsewhere.

- Build trusted reporting and help teams self-serve routine questions, so your time goes on the problems that matter most.

- Use AI and LLM-assisted techniques to speed up analysis, customer understanding and insight generation.

You'll be great for this role if…

- You form your own view of why something happened and what the business should do about it — not just report what happened.

- You've influenced senior stakeholders with data, including changing a decision or overturning a long-held assumption.

- You understand the economics of a digital consumer product: acquisition, activation, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and unit economics.

- You're fluent in product analytics — funnel, cohort, segmentation and behavioural analysis.

- You have strong SQL and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar.

- You use a visualisation tool such as Tableau, Looker or Power BI to build reporting that stakeholders actually rely on.

- You turn ambiguous questions into structured analysis and tell a clear, concise story to technical and non technical audiences alike.

- You prioritise by business impact and are comfortable managing several stakeholders and workstreams at once.

Bonus points if you have:

- Experience in consumer fintech, banking, payments or financial services

- Growth or marketing analytics experience, including attribution, CAC and channel performance (e.g. AppsFlyer, Google Analytics)

- Experience modelling customer lifetime value or unit economics

- Experience partnering with fraud, abuse or risk teams

- Depth in experimentation design and the statistics behind it

- Familiarity with dbt or experience working alongside Analytics Engineers

- Python or R for advanced analysis

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%)

🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Consumer Lifecycle
jobs.description:
Senior Product Manager – Consumer Lifecycle

Location: London, United Kingdom

Employment type: Permanent, full-time, Office first

This role does not support Visa sponsorship and candidates must have the right to work in the UK.

Team description

The Consumer Lifecycle team owns the product experience that turns SumUp app signups into active, transacting customers - from onboarding through to first transaction and ongoing engagement.  As the sole Product Manager for consumer activation and engagement, you  will own that funnel end to end, improving conversion at every stage.

What you'll do

- Own the consumer onboarding funnel end to end: signup, identity verification (KYC), first funding, first transaction and habitual use

- Identify and ship product improvements at the biggest drop-off points, starting with the gap between KYC completion and first transaction

- Balance fraud and verification controls with a smooth, user-friendly product experience

- Run discovery, experimentation and iteration cycles against activation targets, and report progress to consumer leadership

You'll be great for this role if…

- Experience leading a consumer product area with clear commercial and KPI accountability

- Strong track record of prioritising effectively across competing demands from multiple teams and stakeholders

- Experience driving engagement or retention within a consumer-facing mobile app used at scale

- Comfort balancing risk or compliance requirements against a smooth, user-friendly product experience

- Ability to build strong relationships across engineering, design, data and marketing, and communicate progress clearly to leadership

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - SuperApp
jobs.description:
About the team:

The Engagement tribe sits at the heart of SumUp's merchant experience, responsible for the product surfaces that 4.3 million business owners interact with every day, from the information they see about their business to the actions they take to grow it. As our Senior Product Manager, you'll own the merchant facing SuperApp end to end, a rare individual contributor role spanning product strategy, UX quality, and squad delivery, on the single surface the wider product organisation depends on to build and ship effectively. If you're looking for a role where your product decisions have a direct impact on how millions of businesses run and scale every day, this is it.

What you'll do:

- Own the end to end product experience of our SuperApp across iOS, Android and web dashboard, raising the bar on UX quality, information architecture, and navigation for the surfaces merchants rely on most

- Spot and execute activation, upsell, cross sell, and retention opportunities that measurably grow engagement and long term value for merchants

- Shape the product strategy that makes the SuperApp an essential, everyday tool for small business owners running their business globally

- Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders across the business who depend on the SuperApp to reach merchants, partnering closely with design and data on priorities

- Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning direct merchant insight into a clear, prioritised roadmap

You'll be great for this role if:

- Track record leading a product squad end to end, from strategy through to shipped outcomes in engagement, retention, or monetisation

- Strong technical or analytical foundation, whether from an engineering background or hands on experience as a data or business analyst, with the ability to think in systems and structure ambiguous problems

- Comfort working fluently with both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, rather than relying on others to surface the answer

- Strong visual and UX judgement, with experience partnering closely with design and giving clear, constructive feedback

- Ability to build a well reasoned product strategy independently, without needing a dedicated research or strategy function to get there

- Experience advocating for merchants, with a track record of translating their everyday problems into practical product decisions

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setu

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days

🏙 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
